class.name: X11WindowSource
class.brief_description: Shows an X11 window of the desktop as a texture and sends it input.
class.description: Connects to the X server ([code]DISPLAY[/code]) with its own connection. A captured window is read through Composite: its pixmap is exported as a dmabuf with DRI3 ([code]BuffersFromPixmap[/code], with the DRM format modifier) and imported once per distinct buffer as a Vulkan image (zero copy). DAMAGE events say when the window changed: an idle window costs one non-blocking read per [method update]. Without DRI3, or if the import fails, the window is copied with MIT-SHM (or plain GetImage) into a texture instead; [method get_stats] says which path is in use. Input goes to the captured window either as synthetic events ([constant INPUT_SEND_EVENT], no focus needed) or through XTEST ([constant INPUT_XTEST], real events that follow the X pointer and keyboard focus). libxcb and its extension libraries are loaded at run time. Call [method update] once per frame from the main thread. [codeblock] var source := X11WindowSource.new() source.open() for w in source.list_windows(): if "Chromium" in w["title"]: source.capture(w["id"]) material.set_shader_parameter("window_tex", source.get_texture()) # Every frame: source.update() source.send_pointer(x, y) [/codeblock] The texture holds the window's sRGB-encoded values in a UNORM format; decode them in the shader for 3D use.

method.name: capture
method.description: Starts showing [param window] (an X window id, e.g. [code]id[/code] from [method list_windows]) in [method get_texture].

method.name: close
method.description: Stops the capture and closes the X connection.

method.name: close_window
method.description: Asks the window to close (ICCCM [code]WM_DELETE_WINDOW[/code]), as a window manager's close button does.

method.name: get_atom
method.description: The X atom for [param name] (created if needed), e.g. for [method send_client_message] data.

method.name: delete_window_property
method.description: Deletes a property of any window.

method.name: gamescope_focus
method.description: Asks gamescope (in Steam-controlled focus mode) to show [param window]: gives its toplevel a [code]STEAM_GAME[/code] id if it has none (or [param app_id]), and names it in the root's [code]GAMESCOPECTRL_BASELAYER_WINDOW[/code].

method.name: gamescope_release_focus
method.description: Deletes [code]GAMESCOPECTRL_BASELAYER_WINDOW[/code] again if [method gamescope_focus] set it.

method.name: get_capture_mode
method.description: The path in use for the captured window.

method.name: get_extensions
method.description: Versions of the X extensions used (Composite, DAMAGE, XFixes, XTEST, DRI3, MIT-SHM).

method.name: get_focus_info
method.description: The focus state: gamescope's root properties ([code]GAMESCOPE_FOCUSED_WINDOW[/code], [code]GAMESCOPE_FOCUSED_APP[/code], [code]GAMESCOPE_FOCUSABLE_WINDOWS[/code], [code]GAMESCOPECTRL_BASELAYER_WINDOW[/code], [code]GAMESCOPECTRL_BASELAYER_APPID[/code]...), [code]_NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW[/code], the X input focus and our own window.

method.name: get_own_window
method.description: The X window id of this program's main window (0 if the display server isn't X11).

method.name: get_size
method.description: The captured window's size in pixels.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Counters: [code]mode[/code], [code]zero_copy[/code], [code]format[/code], [code]modifier[/code], [code]damage_events[/code], [code]frames_updated[/code], [code]frames_deferred[/code], [code]imports[/code], [code]buffers_cached[/code], [code]buffer_switches[/code], [code]copies[/code], [code]bytes_copied[/code], [code]fetch_ms_avg[/code], [code]fetch_ms_max[/code], [code]x_errors[/code], [code]input_events[/code], [code]dmabuf_error[/code], [code]last_error[/code].

method.name: get_texture
method.description: The window's picture. The same texture stays valid across resizes and recaptures; it is opaque black while nothing is captured.

method.name: get_toplevel
method.description: The ancestor of [param window] that is a child of the root window.

method.name: get_window
method.description: The captured window's id, or 0.

method.name: get_window_info
method.description: The same fields as one entry of [method list_windows].

method.name: get_window_property
method.description: A property of any window: a [PackedInt64Array] for 32- and 16-bit types, a [String] for 8-bit ones, [code]null[/code] if it isn't set.

method.name: has_alpha
method.description: True for 32-bit (ARGB, premultiplied) windows.

method.name: list_windows
method.description: The toplevel windows, bottom to top. Each: [code]id[/code] (the client window), [code]frame[/code] (its toplevel ancestor), [code]title[/code], [code]class[/code], [code]instance[/code], [code]pid[/code], [code]x[/code], [code]y[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]depth[/code], [code]mapped[/code], [code]override_redirect[/code], [code]steam_game[/code].

method.name: open
method.description: Connects to the X server ([code]DISPLAY[/code] if [param display] is empty).

method.name: raise_window
method.description: Raises the window's toplevel in the X stacking order and sends [code]_NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW[/code] to the window manager.

method.name: remap_window
method.description: Unmaps and maps the window's toplevel again. gamescope prefers the most recently mapped window.

method.name: send_button
method.description: An X button: 1 left, 2 middle, 3 right, 4-7 wheel, 8 back, 9 forward.

method.name: send_client_message
method.description: A 32-bit ClientMessage about [param window], sent to the root (with the substructure masks, for the window manager) unless [param destination] is given.

method.name: send_focus_in
method.description: A synthetic FocusIn event to the captured window.

method.name: send_godot_key
method.description: A Godot [enum Key] mapped to an X keysym (letters as their lowercase keysym).

method.name: send_key
method.description: An X keysym. Keysyms that no key produces are put on a spare keycode for the time they are used.

method.name: send_pointer
method.description: Moves the pointer to window pixel ([param x], [param y]).

method.name: send_scroll
method.description: Wheel notches (fractions accumulate). Positive [param dy] scrolls down, positive [param dx] right.

method.name: send_text
method.description: Presses and releases a key for every character.

method.name: set_input_focus
method.description: Sets the X keyboard focus (what XTEST key events follow).

method.name: set_input_passthrough
method.description: Gives the window an empty input shape, so pointer events go to the window below it (e.g. our own window, so XTEST clicks reach the captured window under it).

method.name: set_preferred_mode
method.description: [constant CAPTURE_DMABUF] (default), or a copy path, used by the next [method capture].

method.name: set_window_property
method.description: Sets a 32-bit property ([code]CARDINAL[/code], [code]WINDOW[/code], [code]ATOM[/code] or any type name) of any window.

method.name: update
method.description: Processes X events and refreshes the texture if the window changed. Returns [code]true[/code] when the texture got new content.

signal.name: window_closed
signal.description: The captured window was destroyed (or the X connection was lost).

constants.constant: Zero copy: the window's pixmap imported as a Vulkan image.
MIT-SHM GetImage into shared memory, then an upload (CPU copy).
GetImage through the X socket, then an upload (CPU copy).
Synthetic events (SendEvent) to the captured window; no focus or stacking needed. Some programs ignore them.
XTEST fake input: real events, delivered to the window under the X pointer and to the X keyboard focus.
